chapter_title: Adhyay 1: Arjuna Vishada - Jab Man Toot Jaye
text:
Jab jeevan me har disha se sankat gher lein, jab apne hi paraye lagne lagein, aur lagne lage ki sab kuch chhod kar bhaag jayein... tab paanch hazaar varsh pehle Kurukshetra ke maidan me ek mahan dhanurdhar bhi isi tarah toot gaya tha.

Arjuna ne kaanpte haathon se kaha:
सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।
वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते॥

Hey Krishna! Mere ang shithil ho rahe hain, mera mukh sookh raha hai, aur mera shareer thar-thar kaanp raha hai. Mera Gandiva dhanush mere haathon se chhoot raha hai. Mujhme ab khade rahne ki bhi shakti nahi bachi.

Dosto, yeh kewal Arjuna ki vyatha nahi thi. Yeh har us insaan ki sthiti hai jo aaj jeevan ki bhag-daud, tanav, failure aur akelepan ke bojh tale dab chuka hai. Hum sabhi ke jeevan me ek aisi ghadi aati hai jab raste band ho jaate hain. Lekin jab insaan apni seemaon ko sweekar kar leta hai, wahi se param satya aur Bhagavad Gita ke divya gyan ka aarambh hota hai. Shri Krishna muskuraye aur unhone Arjuna ko woh drishti di jisne ek kaanpte hue insaan ko aje-ya yoddha bana diya.

chapter_title: Adhyay 2: Sankhya Yoga - Atma Amar Hai, Chinta Chhodo
theme: Overcoming the Fear of Death, Loss & Insecurity
text:
Hum jeevan me sabse zyada tab rote hain jab hum kisi cheez ko kho dete hain. Lekin Bhagwan Krishna ne Arjuna se kaha: Tum uske liye shok kar rahe ho jo shok karne yogya nahi hai.

Krishna ne ek anmol satya bataya:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि।
तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्ण्यान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही॥

Hey Partha! Jaise ek insaan apne purane aur phate hue vastron ko tyag kar naye vastra dharan karta hai... theek waise hi yeh divya atma is maransheel purane shareer ko chhod kar naya shareer dharan karti hai.

Ise na shastra kaat sakte hain, na aag jala sakti hai, na jal ise geela kar sakta hai, aur na hawa ise sukha sakti hai. Yeh atma nitya, sarvavyapi aur amar hai. Jab tumhara mool swaroop amar hai, toh fir asafalta ka kaisa darr? Kisi cheez ke khone ka kaisa dukh? Tum sansar me kuch laaye nahi the, jo khone ka darr paal rahe ho. Utho, aur apne andar ki anant shakti ko pehchano.

chapter_title: Adhyay 3: Karma Yoga - Karm Ka Param Rahasya
theme: Peak Focus, Detached Action & Beating Procrastination
text:
Aaj 99 percent log isliye bechain aur dukhi hain kyunki unka 10 percent dhyan kaam par hota hai aur 90 percent dhyan uske result par. Krishna ne is manasik bimari ka sabse bada ilaj bataya.

Shri Krishna kahte hain:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥

Hey Arjuna! Tera adhikar kewal karm karne par hai, uske phalon par kabhi nahi. Isliye karm ke phal ka hetu mat ban, aur karm na karne me bhi teri aashakti na ho.

Iska gahra arth samjho. Jab tum kaam karte waqt lagataar yeh sochte ho ki 'Mujhe kya milega? Log kya kahenge? Main haar gaya toh kya hoga?' tab tumhari aadhi shakti chinta me nasht ho jati hai. Phal tumhare haath me nahi hai, lekin tumhara prayas tumhare haath me hai. Karm ko poori nishtha aur lagan se pooja bana do. Jab tum phal ki chinta chhod kar kewal karm me doob jaate ho, tabhi safalta tumhare kadam choomti hai.

chapter_title: Adhyay 4: Dhyana Yoga - Ashant Man Ko Bas Me Kaise Karein
text:
Arjuna ne ek aisi samasya uthayi jo aaj har yuva aur har insaan ki sabse badi samasya hai. Arjuna ne kaha: Hey Krishna! Yeh man hawa ki tarah chanchal hai. Ise rokna toh tufan ko mutthi me band karne jaisa asambhav lagta hai. Is ashaant man ko kaise bas me karein?

Bhagwan Krishna ne muskura kar iska sthayi samadhan diya:
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥

Hey Mahabahu! Isme koi sandeh nahi ki man bahut chanchal aur mushkil se vash me aane wala hai. Lekin ise do cheezon se jeeta ja sakta hai: Pehla Abhyas, yaani consistent practice, aur doosra Vairagya, yaani anavashyak icchaon aur bhatkav se doori.

Jab bhi tumhara man bhatke, use daanto mat, use dhyan se pakad kar wapas apne lakshya par lagao. Roz thoda dhyan, shant baithna aur apne vicharon ka sakshi banna hi abhyas hai. Jisne apne man ko jeet liya, uska man uska sabse bada mitra ban jata hai. Aur jo man ke aage haar gaya, uska man hi uska sabse bada shatru ban jata hai.

chapter_title: Adhyay 5: Moksha Sannyasa Yoga - Param Samarpan aur Vijay
theme: Ultimate Surrender, Supreme Confidence & Fearless Living
text:
Jab saare tarka, saari chintayein aur saari yojanaayein samaapt ho jaati hain, tab aati hai sharanagati ki amritmayi shakti. Shri Krishna ne Gita ke antim adhyay me apna sabse divya vachan diya.

Bhagwan ne kaha:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥

Hey Arjuna! Sabhi dharmo, sabhi chintaon, sabhi darr aur samaj ke niyamoka bojh chhod kar kewal meri sharan me aa jaao. Main tumhe sabhi paapon aur sabhi bandhano se mukt kar dunga, shok mat karo.

Yeh vachan sunte hi Arjuna ke hriday ka sara andhera chhat gaya. Uska moh nasht ho gaya. Usne apne aasu ponchhe, Gandiva dhanush uthaya aur bola: 'Karishye Vachanam Tava'—Hey Prabhu, main wahi karunga jo aapka aadesh hai.

Dosto, aapka Kurukshetra aapka jeevan hai. Aapke darr, aalsya aur sandeh hi aapke shatru hain. Shri Krishna ka gyan aapke sath hai. Apne kartavya ke rath par swaar hoiye aur vijay ki or aage badhiye. Jai Shri Krishna.
